caption: Two mechanisms compare acid-driven mineral loss with saliva- and fluoride-supported repair in early caries.
question: What imbalance causes dental caries to progress?
answer: Acid-driven demineralisation exceeds remineralisation; early noncavitated mineral loss can be repaired.
